name: Don't Mess with the Angel
description: When Marichuy was born, her mother—believing she was on the verge of death—handed her over to a priest, who took her to an orphanage. At the age of fourteen, Marichuy ran away from the institution and began wandering from place to place, scraping together a living however she could. Years later, she was attacked by a drunkard; the incident left her harboring resentment toward men and plagued by harrowing nightmares.

credits_cast.character: Viviana Mayer Montenegro de San Román
credits_cast.name: Nailea Norvind

videos.title: A Big Secret
videos.overview: Marichuy is a cheerful, hard-working young woman who lives in a poor neighborhood of the city and harbors a terrible secret. Juan Miguel lives in an unhappy marriage, driven only by the love of his young daughter.

videos.title: Sad Memories
videos.overview: Juan Miguel is impressed by Marichuy's beauty. Viviana feels bored with her marriage to Juan Miguel. Marichuy suffers when she remembers her life of deprivation, while Cecilia regrets abandoning her daughter.

videos.title: Seeking Freedom
videos.overview: Marichuy convinces Juan Miguel of her innocence so she can be released. Viviana asks Juan Miguel for a divorce.

videos.title: Terrible Accident
videos.overview: The plane Juan Miguel and Viviana are traveling in crashes into the sea.

videos.title: Feigned Death
videos.overview: While Viviana survives the accident, Onelia makes Mayita believe Juan Miguel killed her mother.

videos.title: Lies
videos.overview: Isabela tricks Cecilia into believing that Estefanía is the daughter she abandoned. Marichuy confesses to Father Anselmo that a man abused her. Juan Miguel expresses to Patricio his interest in helping Marichuy.

videos.title: False Daughter
videos.overview: Cecilia confesses the truth to Patricio about the daughter she abandoned, and they agree to take Estefanía in. Viviana calls Juan Miguel's house looking for Onelia. Marichuy steals milk from the neighborhood to help the children at the orphanage.

videos.title: A New Life
videos.overview: Marichuy asks Juan Miguel to help her so she doesn't go to jail.

videos.title: Looking for Love
videos.overview: Marichuy feels lost in Juan Miguel's house and wants to leave.

videos.title: New Feelings
videos.overview: Cecilia suggests that Estefanía organize a reception to introduce her to society.

videos.title: New Home
videos.overview: Cecilia welcomes Marichuy into her home, causing distrust in Estefanía and Isabela.

videos.title: Emotions
videos.overview: Marichuy denies to Estefanía that she's in love with Juan Miguel. Viviana enjoys her life away from Juan Miguel.

videos.title: Noncompliance
videos.overview: Marichuy has a problem with Patricio because of Amador. Marichuy and Rocío have fun in Chapultepec. Isabela learns more about Marichuy's past and suspects she may be Cecilia's daughter.

videos.title: Fight
videos.overview: Marichuy and Estefanía argue over a photograph of Juan Miguel. While Juan Miguel can't stop thinking about Marichuy, she suffers Isabela's humiliation. Adrián questions Marichuy about her feelings toward him and Juan Miguel.

videos.title: Defense
videos.overview: Amador tries to assault Marichuy, but she fights back and hits him on the head. Marichuy's nightmares return, attracting Cecilia and Estefanía's attention.

videos.title: The Hidden Truth
videos.overview: Isabela discovers that Marichuy is Cecilia's real daughter. Marichuy falls for Amador's trick and is forced to get closer to him.

videos.title: New Lies
videos.overview: Isabella assures Patricio that Marichuy is not the good woman she claims to be.

videos.title: Lies Exposed
videos.overview: Juan Miguel discovers that Viviana is stealing from him. Isabella carries out her plans to find out if Marichuy is a bad woman.

videos.title: Ruined Party
videos.overview: Estefanía confronts Juan Miguel to find out if he is in love with Marichuy.

videos.title: False Commitment
videos.overview: Marichuy becomes jealous when she sees Estefanía kiss Juan Miguel. Viviana discovers that her lover is a thief.

videos.title: Accusations of Love
videos.overview: Marichuy suffers when she learns that Juan Miguel has decided to marry Estefanía.

videos.title: Nightmares
videos.overview: Marichuy assures Cecilia that a man wants to abuse her.

videos.title: The Wedding's Cancelled
videos.overview: Juan Miguel devises a plan to discover the origin of Marichuy's nightmares.

videos.title: False Accusations
videos.overview: Marichuy is upset to learn that Patricio accuses her of being a thief.

videos.title: Sad Farewell
videos.overview: Marichuy discovers that Estefanía is the one responsible for Patricio's jewelry disappearing.

videos.title: Displays of Love
videos.overview: Juan Miguel kisses Marichuy to show her the immense love he feels for her.

videos.title: Confessions
videos.overview: Juan Miguel carries out his plans to find out the reason for Marichuy's nightmares.

videos.title: Forbidden Love
videos.overview: Juan Miguel confesses to Marichuy the immense love he feels for her.

videos.title: Tragic Accident
videos.overview: Juan Miguel confesses to Patricio the great love he feels for Marichuy.

videos.title: Serious Offenses
videos.overview: Juan Miguel carries out his plans to marry Marichuy.

videos.title: Great Day
videos.overview: Juan Miguel and Marichuy's wedding day has arrived.

videos.title: The Man from the Nightmares
videos.overview: Marichuy finds out Juan Miguel is the man from her nightmares.

videos.title: Destruction
videos.overview: While Juan Miguel and Marichuy celebrate their wedding night, she has another nightmare and realizes that the man haunting her dreams is Juan Miguel.

videos.title: Ugliness
videos.overview: Marichuy leaves Acapulco when she discovers that Juan Miguel is the man of her nightmares.

videos.title: Mercies
videos.overview: Motivated by Eduardo, Juan Miguel goes to see Marichuy once more in the hope that she will forgive him.

videos.title: Divorce
videos.overview: Candelaria informs Marichuy that Juan Miguel is willing to continue the divorce process whenever she wants.

videos.title: No Excuses
videos.overview: Mr. Carrillo informs Juan Miguel that Adrián is advising Marichuy on her divorce.

videos.title: Unexpected Return
videos.overview: Marichuy and Juan Miguel have an unexpected encounter at the hospital when they both go to visit Rocío before she undergoes surgery.

videos.title: Love Struggle
videos.overview: Adrián gives Marichuy a summons to appear as a witness in court for Juan Miguel's custody trial, while Juan Miguel accuses Oneida of her lawsuit and of wanting to take the child away from him.

videos.title: Recovery
videos.overview: The judge rules in favor of Juan Miguel and closes the case, while Attorney del Villar is very upset.

videos.title: Meetings
videos.overview: The doctor gives Marichuy good news: she's pregnant.

videos.title: New Protagonist
videos.overview: Juan Miguel tells Marichuy that he is disappointed because she spoke out against him.

videos.title: Inevitable
videos.overview: All the neighbors watch the program where Marichuy acts.

videos.title: Beautiful Invitation
videos.overview: Gabriel kicks Viviana out of the house and she sees that the situation is getting dangerous for her.

videos.title: Unexpected Kiss
videos.overview: Marichuy confesses to Cande that she is pregnant.

videos.title: Truths Revealed
videos.overview: Cecilia meets Father Anselmo, who tells her that he was the one to whom she gave her newborn daughter.

videos.title: Great Falsehood
videos.overview: Marichuy tries to forgive Juan Miguel and tell him she's pregnant, but Viviana's return could change everything.

videos.title: Good News
videos.overview: Mariana confirms to Mayita that Marichuy is going to give her a little brother, while Marichuy tells Adrián that she has decided to leave the artistic world.

videos.title: Too Late
videos.overview: Marichuy and Candelaria are surprised to receive a visit from Amador and he finds out that Marichuy is pregnant.

videos.title: Missing
videos.overview: Estefanía tells Juan Miguel that Marichuy disappeared.

videos.title: Turnmoil
videos.overview: Onelia goes to the psychiatric hospital to see Viviana and asks Juan Miguel for help.

videos.title: Pirahna Lurking
videos.overview: Rocío meets the doctor who is going to operate on her and falls in love with him, but she talks to Vicente and tells him she wants to see him.

videos.title: Returning Home
videos.overview: Despite not being able to walk, Vicente goes to the hospital to see Rocío after her surgery.

videos.title: The Spy
videos.overview: Viviana confesses to Estefanía that she pretends to have amnesia to win over Juan Miguel.

videos.title: Valuable Information
videos.overview: Amador discovers where Marichuy is and wants to talk to her.

videos.title: Love in the Air
videos.overview: Juan Miguel confirms to Viviana that Marichuy is out of his life and no longer means anything to him.

videos.title: Plan for Seduction
videos.overview: Marichuy has a bad feeling and wants to talk to Juan Miguel's family.

videos.title: Bad Feeling
videos.overview: Viviana is intrigued by Blanca's life and is going to investigate her.

videos.title: Distrust
videos.overview: Marichuy has complications during pregnancy and may lose the baby.

videos.title: Unusual Behavior
videos.overview: Marichuy has a nightmare in which she dreams that they want to take her newborn baby away from her.

videos.title: Confess the Truth
videos.overview: Juan Miguel asks Estefanía to tell him Marichuy's whereabouts and goes to the Velarde house to tell them the truth about Marichuy.

videos.title: Fatal Encounter
videos.overview: Viviana discovers Juan Miguel and Ivette together.

videos.title: True Feelings
videos.overview: Leopardo proposes to Lily to protect her, take care of her and be an exemplary father to his son.

videos.title: True Love
videos.overview: Juan Miguel threatens Viviana with looking for the people she was with so he can divorce her and be able to be with Marichuy.

videos.title: Baby on the Way
videos.overview: Viviana tells Juan Miguel that she's pregnant. Unfortunately for her, he thinks she is lying to him again.

videos.title: Great Doubt
videos.overview: Juan Miguel confesses to Father Anselmo that he would give anything to have a child and asks if it's true that Marichuy is pregnant.

videos.title: Significant Help
videos.overview: Leopardo asks Micaela and Lala for their support during Lirio's birth, even though he doesn't feel capable of helping her.

videos.title: At Risk
videos.overview: Lily's already in labor; Leopard tries to save her and the baby.

videos.title: Awful Tragedy
videos.overview: Ivette and Viviana have an unfortunate confrontation that ends in tragedy.

videos.title: Breaking News
videos.overview: Juan Miguel informs Onelia that Viviana is dead, and Onelia accuses him of the death of her daughter.

videos.title: Real Killer
videos.overview: Juan Miguel asks Patricio for support in connection with Viviana's murder.

videos.title: Guilty Feelings
videos.overview: Estefanía and Patricio help Juan Miguel and investigate Ivette Dorleak.

videos.title: Bad News
videos.overview: Amador learns he's a father. The police find a photo in Ivette's house, and Balbina identifies her.

videos.title: I didn't kill her!
videos.overview: Piranha steals Marichuy's baby and tries to drown it in the river.

videos.title: Two in one
videos.overview: Juan Miguel's lawyer secures his release on bail.

videos.title: It is me!
videos.overview: Juan Miguel explains to everyone that Blanca is a case of split personality.

videos.title: Dressed to kill
videos.overview: Amador tries to convince Marichuy to do another television show.

videos.title: That's the question
videos.overview: Onelia warns Lozada about accepting Blanca's case, but Lozada decides to accept it.

videos.title: A Fresh Start
videos.overview: Marichuy tells Leopardo that she has decided to marry him.

videos.title: Adding Up Loneliness
videos.overview: Marichuy is determined not to reject Leopardo's love and marry him.

videos.title: Passion and Death
videos.overview: The detectives inform Juan Miguel that Viviana was wanted for the murder of her alleged lover.

videos.title: Unexpected Departure
videos.overview: Marichuy wants to be with Juan Miguel and despite Candelaria's opposition, they leave Leopardo's ranch.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: Blanca's trial for Viviana's murder is underway.

videos.title: Regain Love
videos.overview: Feeling that Juan Miguel has forgotten about her, Marichuy decides to leave him but stays in the city.

videos.title: Out of the Neighborhood
videos.overview: Marichuy asks Amador for a job as an actress. Cecilia speaks with Father Anselmo to try to locate Marichuy.

videos.title: In the search
videos.overview: Leopardo searches for Marichuy in the neighborhood, but can't find her.

videos.title: Close Encounter
videos.overview: Juan Miguel goes to jail to talk to Blanca, and she asks him if he still wants to marry her. While riding her bike, Marichuy runs into Juan Miguel.

videos.title: Where is she?
videos.overview: Estefanía tells Patricio that she knows where Marichuy is and that he can get rid of her. Juan Miguel thinks Marichuy is back in the neighborhood and goes to see if she's there.

videos.title: Unexpected Truth
videos.overview: Juan Miguel tries to help Blanca recover her memory. Marichuy wants to forget about Juan Miguel forever.

videos.title: Finding Treasure
videos.overview: During the trial, Father Anselmo defends Blanca and Juan Miguel. Marichuy insists she doesn't want to know who her parents are.

videos.title: Accident
videos.overview: Patricio thinks Estefanía wants Blanca to stay in jail. Juan Miguel thinks Blanca killed her sister, and she doesn't want to talk about it. Cecilia has an accident and is in serious condition.

videos.title: Bad Day
videos.overview: Candelaria confirms to Juan Miguel that Marichuy is getting married. Estefanía waits for Cecilia to die in the hospital to prevent her from bringing Marichuy home.

videos.title: On the Brink of Death
videos.overview: Marichuy learns that Cecilia had an accident and regrets having treated her badly. Cecilia asks Father Anselmo to speak to Marichuy if she dies. Estefanía has a feeling that Cecilia is dead.

videos.title: Stage Play
videos.overview: Amador scolds Marichuy for calling the hospital to check on Cecilia. The play was a success, and backstage, Marichuy meets Juan Miguel.

videos.title: Unknown Child
videos.overview: Juan Miguel realizes that Lirio and Marichuy are the same person. The Leopard tells Juan Miguel the story of how he met Lirio, and Juan Miguel goes to see her because he wants to see his son.

videos.title: Stolen Heart
videos.overview: Marichuy tells Juan Miguel that their son is dead.

videos.title: Lies
videos.overview: Omar tells Juan Miguel that Marichuy lives with Amador and also learns that their child didn't die. Marichuy lies to Juan Miguel, telling him that the baby was conceived with Amador.

videos.title: Disease Analysis
videos.overview: Blanca crashes out in court when she sees Juan Miguel being cunningly accused by the prosecutor. Omar looks for Marichuy and offers to forgive her everything and return with him to the estate.

videos.title: Disowned Fatherhood
videos.overview: Blanca transforms into Ivette during the trial and shoots Juan Miguel. Omar tells Lirio that Marichuy is the Velarde's daughter. Patricio contemptuously confesses to Marichuy that he is her father.

videos.title: The Show Must Go On
videos.overview: Marichuy rejects Patricio for his arrogance and, devastated, must continue with the theatrical performances. Omar meets Blanca and is surprised by her resemblance to Ivette. Father Anselmo assures Juan Miguel that Marichuy's baby is his.

videos.title: Hallucinations
videos.overview: Marichuy tells Juan Miguel her reasons for fleeing and hiding her baby, and he rejects her. Juan Miguel confesses to Blanca that he has found Marichuy, and she decides to let him go. Omar meets Ivette and thinks he is going crazy.

videos.title: Parental Care
videos.overview: Cecilia encounters her grandson and immediately informs Patricio. Marichuy is working and her baby has a fever. Juan Miguel learns of this and rushes to care for his son.

videos.title: Love's not up for debate
videos.overview: Juan Miguel confesses to Omar that he is the father of Lirio's baby and that her real name is Marichuy. Cecilia goes looking for Marichuy, but she rejects her.

videos.title: Willingly by force
videos.overview: Ivette goes looking for Omar, but he tells her that he is in love with Marichuy and threatens her. Omar tells Marichuy that they will return to the ranch even if he has to force her.

videos.title: Paternal surname
videos.overview: Juan Miguel threatens Marichuy with taking her baby away if she doesn't give up her acting career. Blanca questions Juan Miguel and urges him to get back together with Marichuy. Father Anselmo learns that Juan Miguel has begun proceedings to recognize his son.

videos.title: Threat and Sacrifice
videos.overview: Ivette threatens Marichuy, demanding that she leave Omar. Blanca asks Marichuy if she would go back to Juan Miguel if he disappeared. Juan Miguel shows up at the christening and asks Marichuy to admit that they still love each other.

videos.title: Christening
videos.overview: Juan Miguel arrives at his son's christening, surprising everyone. Father Anselmo tells Marichuy that Juan Miguel has recognized his son and that he will be named Juan Miguel San Román Velarde.

videos.title: Fighting against feelings
videos.overview: Cecilia arrives at Marichuy's son's christening party. Candelaria advises Marichuy to talk to Juan Miguel for the sake of her son and tell him that she loves him. Ivette continues trying to seduce Omar.

videos.title: The Proposal
videos.overview: Leopardo asks Marichuy to save him from Ivette because only she can do it, and she agrees to marry Leopardo. At Nelson's wake, Omar confesses to Juan Miguel that Marichuy has accepted his marriage proposal.

videos.title: Upcoming Wedding
videos.overview: Blanca asks Leopardo to take her to Juan Miguel's house, as she fears that Ivette will cause trouble. Juan Miguel asks Marichuy if it is true that she is going to marry Omar, and Marichuy asks him to stop bothering her.

videos.title: Another Home
videos.overview: Ivette surprises Leopardo in his hotel room and threatens to kill him if he doesn't leave Marichuy. Omar tells Juan Miguel that he will take Marichuy to his ranch. Leopardo begins to suspect that Blanca is Ivette.

videos.title: By force
videos.overview: Juan Miguel begs Omar not to take Marichuy and her son away from him. Patricio tells Marichuy that he came for her to take her to the ranch with her mother.

videos.title: Successful Exhibition
videos.overview: Vicente puts together an exhibition of his paintings, the main one being that of Marichuy, which leaves many impressed.

videos.title: The Rescue
videos.overview: Rocío warns Juan Miguel that Blanca must leave. Ivette attacks Cecilia and Marichuy, and steals the baby.

videos.title: Mother
videos.overview: Blanca arrives at Juan Miguel's house with the baby, and everyone is shocked. Marichuy apologizes to Cecilia, as she has shown her that she truly loves her like a daughter for having come between her and Ivette.

videos.title: Tough Choice
videos.overview: Marichuy goes to visit her mother, but Patricio kicks her out and forces Cecilia to choose between Marichuy and him. Israel confesses to Estefanía that he is going to marry Becky.

videos.title: Ready Wedding
videos.overview: Juan Miguel asks Patricio to try to get closer to Marichuy. Everything is ready for Rocío and Vicente's wedding. Marichuy tells Blanca that if she doesn't tell Juan Miguel what Ivette did to Omar, she will.

videos.title: Research
videos.overview: Rocío and Vicente get married. Ivette escapes from the hospital to go to the hotel room where Omar is staying, and Juan Miguel follows her. Juan Miguel is surprised to see Ivette and Omar kissing.

videos.title: Elections
videos.overview: Cecilia confesses to Marichuy that Estefanía and Isabela usurped her. Estefanía poisons Patricio, who tells her that he will not be an enemy to his own wife and prefers to leave home.

videos.title: Requests
videos.overview: Marichuy tells Patricio that Cecilia will suffer greatly if she leaves home and that she has no intention of returning to live with them to avoid being a burden or a nuisance again.

videos.title: Mixed Feelings
videos.overview: Juan Miguel and Marichuy are Israel and Becky's wedding godparents. Omar is jealous that Marichuy sees Juan Miguel so often, but he also has feelings for Blanca.

videos.title: Evil Plans
videos.overview: Blanca confesses to Juan Miguel that she felt jealous of Marichuy and Omar, and proposes that they join forces to separate them. Estefanía goes to the theater but is surprised by a gun, which makes her nervous.

videos.title: Fight for love
videos.overview: Amador decides to go find Beatriz so he can continue to annoy her. Meanwhile, Juan Miguel and Leopardo have a heated confrontation as they fight for Marichuy's love.

videos.title: Serious Accident
videos.overview: Blanca finally confesses to Leopardo that she loves him, but he doesn't believe a word she says. During rehearsals for the play, Marichuy has an unfortunate accident and is seriously injured.

videos.title: Decisions
videos.overview: The doctor informs Juan Miguel that Marichuy's life is in danger. Faced with this terrible news, Patricio summons his courage and makes an important decision as a father.

videos.title: Another Operation
videos.overview: Marichuy thinks she is going to die and asks her mother to take care of her son. Amador reproaches Ana Julia for her carelessness with the gun. The doctors ask Patricio for his authorization to operate on Marichuy.

videos.title: Losing Sight
videos.overview: Ramón and Ana Julia declare that they saw a woman who was not part of the theater and describe her. Isabela and Estefanía become hysterical because they think they will go to jail. After the operation, Marichuy loses her sight and Omar blames Juan Miguel.

videos.title: Presumed Guilty
videos.overview: Cecilia tells Patricio that Marichuy lost her sight. Patricio claims that Estefanía hates Marichuy and thinks that she may have caused his daughter's accident.

videos.title: Broken Heart
videos.overview: Patricio and Cecilia cannot believe that Estefanía wanted to kill Marichuy, and they insist that she will get what she deserves if she is found guilty.

videos.title: Guilty as Charged
videos.overview: Patricio pressures Isabela to tell the truth, and she finally confesses that Estefanía planned everything to kill Marichuy. Blanca confesses to Omar that she loves him. Estefanía is arrested as the alleged murderer.

videos.title: Dangerous Consequences
videos.overview: Estefania confesses to Patricio that she deeply regrets not killing Marichuy. Isabela and Estefanía reveal their true identities to Patricio and Juan Miguel, and Patricio suffers a heart attack upon hearing their statements.

videos.title: Attempted Murder
videos.overview: Juan Miguel tells Cecilia that Patricio has had a heart attack. Estefanía is found guilty, but she escapes from the police station and goes to Amador's apartment, where she meets Candelaria and Marichuy.

videos.title: Worries
videos.overview: Amador kicks Candelaria and Marichuy out of his apartment because Marichuy is no longer useful to him as an actress. Juan Miguel is worried about Marichuy because he doesn't know where she is.

videos.title: Another Accident
videos.overview: Onelia apologizes to Juan Miguel for all the harm she has caused, and he advises her to also apologize to Marichuy. Marichuy, along with her baby, falls down some stairs and is taken to the hospital, but no one knows Juanito's whereabouts.

videos.title: Guilty Innocent
videos.overview: Juan Miguel asks Marichuy for an explanation of how she lost her son. Upset, he tells her that if anything happens to his son, she will be the only one responsible. Patricio leaves the hospital to look for his grandson.

videos.title: Statements
videos.overview: Patricio and Cecilia visit Marichuy in the neighborhood and offer her their unconditional support. They also ask her to come live with them. Juan Miguel and Marichuy are closer to finding their son. Patricio and Cecilia testify against Estefanía.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: Fermina and Pedro look for Juan Miguel to tell him that their son has been taken to a hospice. Juan Miguel goes to the hospice to look for Juanito, where a doctor informs him that the baby's in critical condition. Marichuy testifies against Estefanía.

videos.title: Hospitalized Due to the Accident
videos.overview: Juan Miguel takes Juanito to the Velarde house and hands him over to Marichuy. Amador kidnaps Beatriz and her son, but unfortunately they suffer a car accident, and Amador is in critical condition at the hospital.

videos.title: Sentence
videos.overview: Isabela, frightened and nervous during the trial interrogation, admits that she knew everything about Estefanía's plans and pleads guilty. Juan Miguel is determined to leave the country to forget Marichuy.

videos.title: To Forget A Love
videos.overview: Juan Miguel leaves the country to forget Marichuy. Marichuy asks Cecilia to give Ana Julia a job so she can take care of her. Juan Miguel confirms to Patricio that Estefanía has lost her mind. Onelia takes Mayita to see Marichuy.

videos.title: Looking for Forgiveness
videos.overview: Isabella devises a plan to escape from prison. Onelia asks Marichuy to forgive her for having been unkind to her. Marichuy is delighted to learn that she may soon regain her sight.

videos.title: For Regaining Vision
videos.overview: Juan Miguel devises a plan to help Marichuy regain her sight. Marichuy suffers a car accident while trying to flee from Juan Miguel.

videos.title: Reproaches
videos.overview: Juan Miguel devises a plan to get Marichuy to forgive him for abandoning her. Ana Julia starts to feel a strong attraction to Juan Miguel. Onelia discovers that Marichuy had an accident because of Juan Miguel.

videos.title: False Hope
videos.overview: Ana Julia carries out her plans to make Juan Miguel fall in love with her. Rocío suffers when she learns that Vicente is not the good man she thought he was.

videos.title: False Friendship
videos.overview: Ana Julia continues with her plans to get rid of Marichuy. Rocío suspects that Vicente is cheating on her with another woman. Ana Julia assures Marichuy that Juan Miguel is not the good man he claims to be.

videos.title: True Love
videos.overview: Juan Miguel confesses to Marichuy how much he loves her. Ana Julia carries out her plans to win Juan Miguel over. Patricio is upset to learn that Juan Miguel continues to harass Marichuy.

videos.title: Unable to See
videos.overview: Juan Miguel devises a plan to restore Marichuy's sight. Cecilia assures Patricio that Juan Miguel is not a bad man.

videos.title: Recovery Process
videos.overview: Patricio carries out his plans to restore Marichuy's sight. Marichuy recalls the best moments she shared with Juan Miguel. Ana Julia assures Marichuy that Juan Miguel does not love her.

videos.title: Grudges
videos.overview: Candelaria asks God to help Marichuy regain her sight. Juan Miguel suffers when he learns that Marichuy has decided to forget him. Ana Julia is upset when she learns that Marichuy could regain her sight.

videos.title: Exhaust All Possibilities
videos.overview: Marichuy will not be able to have surgery and will go blind. Patricio suffers a pre-heart attack, and Marichuy thinks it is Juan Miguel's fault, but Candelaria tells her that he saved Patricio's life. Juan Miguel decides to go abroad to find a way to cure Marichuy.

videos.title: Religious Experience
videos.overview: Ana Julia tells Juan Miguel that she loves him and asks him to forget about Marichuy, but he rejects her. Juan Miguel goes to church to see Marichuy without her noticing. Juan Miguel asks Onelia to keep the reason for his trip a secret.

videos.title: Prejudgement
videos.overview: Juan Miguel secretly goes to say goodbye to his son and see Marichuy, while Ana Julia manipulates her into believing that his trip is for fun. Juan Miguel sends Marichuy flowers for her anniversary, and she rejects them.

videos.title: Caused Accident
videos.overview: Marichuy rescues the flowers Juan Miguel sent her. Onelia takes Mayita to visit her little brother and warns Candelaria not to trust Ana Julia. Ana Julia covers the stairs in grease so that Marichuy will have another accident.

videos.title: Chain Disaster
videos.overview: Marichuy falls down the stairs and is knocked unconscious. Ana Julia blames Candelaria for the accident, but Candelaria also accuses her. Patricio feels bad about the argument and faints. Ana Julia tells Marichuy that her father is dying.

videos.title: Neither time nor distance
videos.overview: Patricio suffers a stroke that leaves his left arm paralyzed. Ana Julia steals Marichuy's jewelry box, where she keeps the orchids Juan Miguel gave her. Juan Miguel calls Marichuy on the phone with the sole intention of hearing her voice.

videos.title: Dying of Anguish
videos.overview: Dr. Durán invites Juan Miguel to work with him. Candelaria finds Marichuy's jewelry box in the trash. Patricio demands that Marichuy forget about Juan Miguel. Ana Julia takes Mayita away without warning, leaving everyone very distressed.

videos.title: Intrigues
videos.overview: Ana Julia arrives with Mayita and lies that she had warned Candelaria. Juan Miguel's surgeries have failed, but Dr. Durán asks him not to give up. Ana Julia lies to Juan Miguel and Marichuy, creating false romances to separate them.

videos.title: The First Success
videos.overview: Juan Miguel achieves his first success in surgery. Amador wants to recover so he can take revenge. Marichuy assures Rocío that she no longer loves Juan Miguel. Ana Julia sends photos to Juan Miguel to make him believe that Marichuy is in love with her cousin.

videos.title: Returning to Mexico
videos.overview: Rafael is Marichuy's new teacher, who is also blind and teaches her to read and fend for herself. Juan Miguel returns to Mexico after graduating from his specialty in Boston and demands to know everything about Marichuy.

videos.title: Revenge Plan

videos.overview: Onelia tells Ana Julia that she will make her life miserable. Patricio forbids any member of the San Román family from visiting and decides to send Marichuy out of Mexico to prevent her from seeing Juan Miguel.

videos.overview: Ana Julia makes Mayita believe that Marichuy no longer loves her. Juan Miguel sees Rafael and Marichuy together and feels jealous. Rafael hears Juan Miguel tell Marichuy that he loves her and asks her to forgive him.

videos.title: False Expectations
videos.overview:
Juan Miguel tries to convince Patricio to give his consent to operate on Marichuy, as he is qualified due to his specialization in ophthalmology, but he fails to convince him.

videos.overview: Ana Julia and Amador will hurt Marichuy through her son and Juan Miguel. Juan Miguel tells Daniel what happened with Ana Julia.

videos.overview: Rocío tells Vicente that she loves Daniel, but he doesn't know about the divorce. Purita's baby has anemia and needs a bone marrow transplant to save his life, but it must come from a family member, so they go to the mother superior to find out who his parents are.

videos.overview: Marichuy tells her family that she is in love with Dr. Cisneros. Ana Julia tells Juan Miguel that she is expecting his child.

videos.overview: Juan Miguel takes Marichuy to church for Father Anselmo's blessing. Ana Julia tells Cecilia and Patricio that she is expecting Juan Miguel's child.

videos.overview: Ana Julia tells Marichuy that she is pregnant and that Juan Miguel has returned to Mexico. Patricio and Cecilia try to stop the operation that has already begun, but Juan Miguel refuses.

videos.overview: Marichuy survives the operation. Amador refuses to help his son with the transplant. Ana Julia tells Mayita that she is pregnant with Juan Miguel's child.

videos.overview: Onelia threatens Ana Julia so she won't mess with her family again. Amador and Vicente kidnap Rafael. Vicente calls to demand a ransom for Rafael, but Juan Miguel recognizes his voice.

videos.overview: Officer Cimarro arrests Vicente. Marichuy regains her sight and discovers that Dr. Cisneros is actually Juan Miguel.

videos.overview: Cimarro and Juan Miguel manage to rescue Rafael. Dr. Reynaldo offers Marichuy a job at a community clinic. Marichuy confesses to Juan Miguel that she has no intention of forgiving him or believing in something that has caused her so much pain.

videos.overview: Marichuy despises Juan Miguel and asks him not to come looking for her again. Ana Julia and Vicente decide to join forces against Amador.

videos.overview: Rafael can see thanks to Juan Miguel's operation. Amador confesses to Marichuy that the child Ana Julia is expecting is his.

videos.title: The Eyes of the Soul
videos.overview: Amador tries to flee the country, but the police manage to arrest him. Marichuy proposes marriage to Juan Miguel, and he accepts.

videos.overview: Rocío and Daniel get married. Marichuy and Juan Miguel plan to renew their vows, but Ana Julia kidnaps Marichuy to kill her and then commit suicide.

videos.overview: Adrián and Purita adopt Ana Julia's baby, who saves Eduardito by providing him with the cells to cure him. Marichuy and Juan Miguel renew their wedding vows and throw a big party in the neighborhood that welcomed Marichuy for so many years.

videos.title: The Triumph of Love
videos.overview: Surrounded by family, friends, and loved ones, Marichuy and Juan Miguel enjoy their celebration. Marichuy and Juan Miguel go on their honeymoon to the beach and, together with Mayita and Juanito, form a close-knit family full of love.
